approach: Use prefix XOR and total XOR to derive right side XOR in O(1) at each index.
observation: If totalXor is known and prefixXor at i is leftXor, then rightXor = totalXor XOR leftXor.
bruteForce: For each i, recompute XOR over left and right ranges. O(n^2).
optimalSolution: Single pass with rolling prefix XOR and precomputed total XOR. Return first i where leftXor > rightXor.
dryRun: nums=[9,1,2]. total=10. i=0: left=9 right=3 => answer 0.
